# State-level weather: validation and test (generated by `scripts/run_statepop_eval.py`)

Git commit `070af0a113`. MAE in MW. Differences are state-capital population-weighted minus 12-city equal-weight (negative = the state-level series is better), 95% block bootstrap.

## Horizon 1 h

| model | 12 cities, validation | state capitals, validation | difference (95% CI) | 12 cities, test | state capitals, test | difference (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|---|
| ridge_full_rel | 1,094 | 1,095 | +1 (-1 to +4) | 1,052 | 1,053 | +1 (-1 to +2) |
| XGBoost S3_weatherA | 1,097 | 1,095 | -2 (-10 to +3) | 1,100 | 1,102 | +3 (-3 to +8) |
| XGBoost S4_full_A | 1,104 | 1,099 | -5 (-12 to +2) | 1,111 | 1,115 | +4 (-3 to +10) |
